description: This file defines functions and constants for building and managing filter columns in a data table, specifically for booking-related data. It includes column visibility settings, column definitions with filtering options, and uses external libraries for table helpers.

methods.name: getFilterColumnVisibility
methods.description: Returns an object indicating that all filter columns are hidden by default.

methods.name: buildFilterColumns
methods.description: Constructs and returns an array of column definitions with filtering options based on provided parameters.
